title: swa.ml target binding 2.3
description: Target assumptions for one deployment of a swa.ml 2.3 model (WP8-M02): execution costs per operation occurrence, budgets per Swaml::Os Task occurrence and cross-core latencies per connection occurrence. Identities use the canonical spelling of the normalized model: operations as the occurrence path from the deployed root plus the operation name (dcu.comMain.rxMainFunction), Tasks as platform occurrence paths (vehicle.doorModules[0].core1.task20ms) and connections as the route identities of runs and traces (owner.name or owner.@connectN for a component connection, name or @packageN for a package connection). `swaml binding check` resolves them against the validated model (WP8-M03). A binding is static resolution of target assumptions; it is neither an analysis claim nor schedulability evidence (WP8-M05).

deployment.description: The deployment's qualified identity in canonical spelling, for example DoorEcu::'Front left door'.

operation.description: Occurrence path from the deployed root plus the operation name.

bcetNs.description: Best-case execution time in nanoseconds; at most wcetNs.

source.description: A reference to the measurement or analysis that supplies the cost.

task.description: Platform occurrence path of a Swaml::Os Task.

budgetNs.description: Execution budget of the Task in nanoseconds.

connection.description: Route identity of a connection occurrence.

maxNs.description: Largest cross-core transfer latency in nanoseconds.
